ipos.name: Shah Investor’s Home
ipos.about: Shah Investor’s Home Ltd is one of the leading retail brokering companies in providing equity brokerage services and derivatives brokerage services. Further, the company provides services that help people buy and sell financial products like stocks, IPOs, mutual funds, and other securities. It has around 100,000 demat accounts, including more than 37,810 active clients, and works with over 184 authorised partners, as of March 31, 2025. The company operates through 11 branches across India, including in Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Vadodara, Junagadh, Gandhinagar, and Rajkot. Financially, Shah Investor’s Home Ltd.’s revenue grew by 19%, and its profit after tax increased by 30% from March 31, 2024, to March 31, 2025.

ipos.name: Acevector
ipos.about: Founded in 2007, AceVector operates a digital commerce ecosystem consisting of data, technology, and AI-driven businesses – a value e-commerce marketplace, e-commerce enablement software as a service (“SaaS”), and consumer brands. AceVector operates through 3 types of businesses: 1) Snapdeal, an e-commerce platform that offers affordable products. 2) Uniware, Convertway, and Shipway offer a suite of e-commerce enablement SaaS products. 3) Stellaro Brands, a consumer brands that sell products through online and offline channels. As of FY26, the company has served its products to over 18,972 PIN codes in India, especially targeting Middle-income and Value-conscious consumers situated in Tier 2+ and smaller cities.

ipos.name: German Green Steel
ipos.about: German Green Steel and Power, founded in 2008, is one of the leading iron and steel manufacturers with a strong presence in Gujarat. Its product range includes TMT Bars, MS Billets, and Sponge Iron, with TMT bar. The firm mainly sells its products on a B2B basis. Its three main types of customers are Distributors, Dealers, and Institutional customers. Moreover, the brand German TMT has maintained its strong presence in TMT Bars in Gujarat. German Green operates 2 manufacturing facilities: one is located in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, and the Samakhiyali Facility is situated close to ports in Gujarat. Furthermore, the firm is planning to expand the existing installed TMT Bars production capacity at the Samakhiyali Facility from 181,500 MTPA to 346,500 MTPA.

ipos.name: Runwal Enterprises
ipos.about: Founded in February 2016, Runwal Enterprises is one of the leading real-estate developers that builds residential homes across affordable, mid-income, and luxury segments, along with commercial spaces, retail malls, and educational buildings. It is a recognized brand in the real estate industry with a strong presence across Mumbai. As of March 2026, the firm has completed 19 projects, 28 are ongoing Projects, and 33 are upcoming. Moreover, Runwal Enterprises also has expertise in developing large townships such as schools, malls, retail shops, and shopping arcades. Furthermore, the company has its own in-house team to design, architect, construct, and handle sales and marketing, contracts, and procurement for residential projects.

ipos.name: Orient Cables
ipos.about: Orient Cables is one of the premier companies in terms of networking cables and passive networking equipment, as the company has been operating it for around 20 years. These are providing to advanced industries such as broadband, telecom, data centres, renewable energy, smart building automation/ security, system integration, FMEG, and automotive. Leading manufacturer of special cables used in telecommunications, wide range of custom-made products and solutions for different industries, factories are in strategic locations and focus on making innovative products are the company’s strengths. Further, the company also provides a wide range of products, including Networking Cables and Solutions; Specialty Power, Optical Fibre Cables and Solutions; and Other Allied Products. In Fiscal 2025, they are among the top five networking cable companies in India, with around 22% market share.

ipos.name: Moneyview
ipos.about: Founded in 2014, Moneyview is a leading Indian financial technology (fintech) company. It is India’s top-rated all-in-one financial app that offers all kinds of financial and lending services. It offers personal loans, credit tracking, and financial management services through its mobile platform. Moneyview uses technology and data analytics to check creditworthiness to ensure quick loan approvals. Its platform operates as a 2-sided network where it connects users who are looking for financial products with banks, NBFCs, insurers, and financial institutions that provide such products. Moreover, Moneyview has expanded its product range across multiple product categories, such as insurance, credit cards, digital gold, payments, and earned wage access.

ipos.name: A-One Steels
ipos.about: A-One Steels India, founded in 2012, is one of the leading steel manufacturers that offers both long and flat steel products and industrial products used in steel manufacturing. The firm basically takes HR and CR coils from MS billets (semi-finished steel materials) and then converts them into HR pipes, CR pipes, and galvanized tubes (finished steel products). The firm also produces TMT bars from MS billets as long steel products and manufactures industrial products like met coke and silicon manganese/ferrosilicon. Its products are used in various industries, including construction, infrastructure, power plants, dams, airports, bridges, flyovers, stadiums, highways, marine structures, industrial buildings, and high-rise residential constructions. Moreover, A-one Steels operates its 6 manufacturing facilities: five in Karnataka (Gauribidanur, Bellary, Koppal, Chikkantapur) and one in Hindupur, Andhra Pradesh.

ipos.name: Adroit Industries
ipos.about: Since its incorporation in January 1995, Adroit Industries has been a leading manufacturer and supplier of propeller shafts and torque-transmission components. Its product portfolio consists of over 5000 products, which includes precision-machined torque-transmission components, complete propeller shaft assemblies, and forged components. Its product range caters to a diverse range of industries such as commercial vehicles, SUVs, defence and emergency services, heavy equipment, off-highway machinery, and industrial applications. Adroit Industries’ manufacturing facility combines advanced forging capabilities, specialized precision machining, heat treatment procedures, final assembly, dynamic balancing, and quality testing, offering end-to-end production capabilities. Furthermore, the firm exports its products to customers across North America, Europe, Latin America, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific.

ipos.name: Swastika Infra
ipos.about: Swastika Infra Limited was founded in 1969 and made a reputation in the Power Distribution EPC infrastructure industry. After completing large-scale power distribution infrastructure projects, it transitioned into the power EPC business in 2011. In 2019, they transferred their foundation into a company, as they are innovative and excellent in their work. Due to 12 years of expertise in EPC, they are advanced in the conceptualization, design, supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of power projects on a turnkey basis. Their team of 100 employees, including 70 skilled professionals, is the foundation of its operations. Further, they are committed to shaping a strong future through sustainable and efficient energy solutions.

ipos.name: Elevate Campuses
ipos.about: Elevate Campuses, founded in 2005, is an education infrastructure firm that owns, operates, and manages on-campus student accommodation for higher education institutions (HEIs). The firm operates under two brands: Good Host Spaces and ScholarZ. Its product portfolio includes 7 owned student accommodation campuses with 20,368 beds across six Indian cities and 14 managed campuses with 55,487 beds. The firm helps businesses find deals, choose locations, develop and buy properties, improve existing properties, and work with local communities. Moreover, Elevate Campuses works with educational institutions, including Manipal Academy of Higher Education, Manipal University, Jaipur, and Meraki Education, to provide accommodation for higher education institutions (HEIs) and own K-12 school assets.

ipos.name: ArMee Infotech
ipos.about: ArMee Infotech Limited (AIL), incorporated in 2003, is an IT infrastructure solutions provider that offers complete technology solutions across sectors including government, corporates, banking, financial services and insurance (BFSI), and education. In addition to IT solutions, the firm is also involved in retail sales and renewable energy. Its services include IT infrastructure, providing IT hardware and software, along with installation, integration, maintenance, and related support services. They also provide IT Managed services, Retail Sales, and Renweable energy solutions. As of June 30, 2026, ArMee Infotech has completed 99 ongoing projects, in which 65 are IT Infrastructure, 21 are IT Managed Services, 10 are Renewable Energy EPC, 1 is Renewable Energy PPA, and 2 are for Renewable Energy BESS. All of its projects are operated in the states of Gujarat, Maharashtra, Bihar, Andhra Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Telangana, Tamil Nadu, Uttarakhand, New Delhi, and Rajasthan.

ipos.name: Varmora Granito
ipos.about: Varmora Granito, founded in 2003, is one of the leading manufacturers of ceramic and vitrified tiles. Its product portfolio consists of a diverse range of tiles across various formats such as glazed vitrified tiles (GVT), polished vitrified tiles (PVT), and ceramic tiles. The firm operates its business through a multi-channel network that consists of B2C and B2B models. Its product portfolio consists of over 3500 products. In the B2C network, the firm sells its products through 286 exclusive brand outlets (EBOs) and over 2,000 multi-brand outlets (MBOs), while in B2B, the firm directly sells its products to Builders, contractors, developers, and government procurement. Moreover, the company has sold its products in 949 cities across 27 states and union territories in India. Furthermore, Varmora Granito operates 9 manufacturing facilities in the Morbi industrial cluster in Gujarat.

ipos.name: Dove Soft
ipos.about: Incorporated in August 2011, Dove Soft Limited provides cloud-based communication solutions that help businesses connect with customers through channels such as SMS, RCS, Voice, WhatsApp, Email, and other digital platforms. The company offers services including SMS solutions, WhatsApp messaging, voice communication, IVR, automated calling, email services, and digital products to enterprises and OTT platforms. Dove Soft serves clients across multiple sectors, including telecom, IT, travel, entertainment, media, advertising, retail, real estate, healthcare, BFSI, automobile, e-commerce, and food & beverage. Its solutions help businesses improve customer communication and simplify their operational processes.

ipos.about: Black Opal Consultants, founded in 2020, is one of the leading real estate companies that partners with real estate developers such as Gaurs Group, SKA, Galaxy, Shapoorji Pallonji, Max Estates, and M3M to market and sell their residential and commercial projects. Its service offerings include Consulting & Advisory Services, Exclusive Sale Arrangements, Loan Syndication Services, and Real Estate Development. Black Opal gets permission from the developer to market and sell certain apartments or residences with exclusive and semi-exclusive rights, and in return it receives brokerage/commission from the developer. The firm has a network of 200 brokers and also uses platforms like Facebook and Google for marketing projects. The firm mainly sells residential and commercial properties that are either newly launched or still under construction.

ipos.name: Dudani Retail
ipos.about: Incorporated in 2015, Dudani Retail is one of the leading designers and manufacturers of apparel and related products. Particularly focusing on offering ladies’ kurtis with elegant style and beautiful designs at affordable prices. Its product portfolio includes ladies’ kurtis, women’s wear, ladies’ suits, fancy tops, rayon ladies’ kurtis, girls’ tops, and men’s shirts, available in different colors, fabrics, and sleeve types, suitable for any work or occasion and for any size. The firm has over 6 years of experience in the manufacturing of women’s ethnic fusion wear and trading men’s wear. The firm operates in Jaipur, Rajasthan, where it handles every process, from cutting and stitching to finishing, quality checks, and dispatch. The firm’s products are sold under various E-commerce websites like Myntra, Amazon, Flipkart, Ajio, Nykaa Fashion, and via our website.

ipos.name: Shree TNB Polymers
ipos.about: Shree TNB Polymers, founded on March 7, 2007, is one of the leading polymer manufacturing firms, focusing on piping systems and plastic solutions. Its product range consists of HDPE pipes & fittings, PP (Polypropylene) and PPH (Polypropylene Homopolymer) pipes & fittings, Double Wall Corrugated (DWC) pipes, sprinkler pipes, drip irrigation systems, solid industrial sheets, and well pack sheets. Its products are mainly used in diverse critical applications such as irrigation and agriculture, potable water supply schemes, sewerage and drainage systems, telecom cable protection, construction, and industrial usage. Shree TNB Polymers operates 2 manufacturing facilities at Silvassa across 23,028 sq. mtrs, backed by in-house quality testing laboratories and BIS/ISO certifications.

ipos.name: Bench Mark Infotech
ipos.about: Established in 2007, Bench Mark Infotech Services Limited provides complete IT and digital infrastructure solutions. The company serves government departments, public sector organisations, institutions, and private businesses across India. The company offers a range of IT and digital infrastructure services, including the supply, installation, and commissioning of IT infrastructure. Its services also cover Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs), facility support, and fibre optic infrastructure solutions. Further, they have completed several projects that showcase their ability to deliver integrated IT and infrastructure solutions. These projects include large network installations, system integration, audio-visual solutions, IoT applications, and virtualisation of important operations. Bench Mark Infotech Services Ltd. saw its revenue grow by 26%, while its profit after tax (PAT) increased by 75% in FY26 compared with FY25.

ipos.name: Sai Urja Indo Ventures
ipos.about: Sai Urja Indo Ventures Limited is one of the leading companies in terms of offering Operation and Maintenance (O&M) and other support services in industrial plants, primarily in the power generation industry and other industries like iron & steel and agrochemicals. Further, they provide a wide range of operation & maintenance services, including breakdown, predictive and preventive maintenance, condition monitoring, all field instruments calibration and testing, and other related activities for power plants and other industries. Moreover, as of mid-June 2026, the company holds 17 active projects with ₹7,165.10 lakh in pending execution, along with another four upcoming projects valued at ₹2,536.74 lakh that have yet to begin.

ipos.name: Himalayan Solar
ipos.about: Established in 2015, Himalayan Solar Limited provides complete solar energy solutions. The company handles the design, manufacturing, supply, installation, and commissioning of various solar products, mainly focusing on Solar Water Pumping Systems. It also offers solutions such as Solar Inverter Charge Systems and Solar Rooftop Power Systems. The company supplies a range of solar products, including solar PV modules, solar cells, solar batteries, and other solar equipment. Moreover, as of 2026, the firm has implemented more than 85000 HP of Solar Water Pumping Systems as part of Government Projects in India. Himalayan Solar’s main mission is to make solar power accessible, affordable, and reliable for everyone.

ipos.name: Green Asia Impex
ipos.about: Founded in 2014, Green Asia Impex has been involved in sourcing, processing, manufacturing, and exporting frozen shrimps and dried chillies. Its product range includes exporting frozen seafood, mainly shrimps, and agri-commodities like red chillies to domestic and international markets. The firm processes and trades different types of shrimps such as Vannamei, Black Tiger, and freshwater shrimp in different forms: HOSO (Head-On Shell-On), HLSO (Headless Shell-On), and PD (Peeled & Deveined). In chillies, it trades and sells a variety of chillies such as Teja, Guntur Sannam, and Bydagi. Shrimp harvesting happens from February to October, and chilli harvests are concentrated between January and April. Moreover, the firm currently operates a semi-automated shrimp processing facility in Unguturu, Andhra Pradesh, and is soon planning to set up a new facility at Chennayagudem.

ipos.name: Peshwa Wheat
ipos.about: Since its foundation in 2023, Peshwa Wheat has been involved in the processing of wheat-based products like Atta (wheat flour), Sortex Wheat, Broken Wheat, and other flour products such as Gram Flour (Besan) and Maize Flour. Moreover, the firm supplies its products mainly in 50 kg and 30 kg packaging. Moreover, during the processing of wheat products, by-products like wheat bran are used to feed cattle, enabling zero waste. Peshwa Wheat sells its products via 2 different business models: the B2B segment, selling products across Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Karnataka, and Gujarat. And sells products through super stockists. Moreover, it also sells its products directly to customers who run restaurants, bakeries, wholesalers, and large buyers and require bulk quantities. Along with flour processing, the firm is also engaged in the trading of vegetables like potatoes and tomatoes.

ipos.name: Roopa Screen
ipos.about: Roopa Screen, incorporated in 2013, manufactures rotary nickel screens for rotary screen-printing machines used in fabric printing. These rotary nickel screens act as stencils, allowing printing paste to pass through and create patterns on fabric. Along with rotary nickel screens, they also trade nickel cathodes, used as a raw material in the nickel screen-making process. Its product portfolio includes Delta Screens, Penta Screens, Standard Screens, and Nova Screens. In FY26, Roopa Screen supplied rotary nickel screens to over 200+ customers in India, including Gujarat, Maharashtra, Haryana, Punjab, and Tamil Nadu. Furthermore, its manufacturing facility is in Taluka Sanand, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, where it carries out all the necessary operations. The company sells its products via both B2B and B2C segments.

ipos.name: Coreintegra Consulting
ipos.about: CoreIntegra Consulting Services, founded in 2009, is one of the leading companies that provide Human Resources (HR) services to businesses. The firm offers staffing, payroll outsourcing, labour law compliance, HR advisory, vendor management, and proprietary HR-Tech and RegTech technologies under one platform. Core Integra offers HR services to help businesses hire employees, manage payroll, and handle HR-related legal requirements to ensure businesses comply with regulatory requirements. The firm provides in-house, tech-driven solutions to let HR work faster and easier through its proprietary platforms CoreX and Core Pay under HR Tech, and Ctrl-F and Core-PFT under RegTech. Furthermore, the company has successfully delivered a wide range of services to more than 600 customers across more than 30 industries, spanning a presence in 23 states and 4 union territories, serving more than 1500 clients.

ipos.name: Unitec Fibres
ipos.about: Unitec Fibres, founded in February 2005, is one of the leading manufacturers of Recycled Polyester Staple Fibre (RPSF). The firm makes sustainable polyester fibres from recycled PET flakes, PET chips, and other polyester waste. The company supplies RPSF to various industries such as automobiles, home furnishings, and textiles, where it is used in carpets, roof liners, trunks, sofas, curtains, and spinning applications. Unitec Fibers operates its 2 manufacturing facilities in Maharashtra and is planning to set up its third facility in Valsad, Gujarat. Moreover, the company follows strict quality standards and holds Global Recycled Standard (GRS) certifications to showcase its commitment to offering quality, sustainable, and recycled products.

ipos.name: S.K.Offset
ipos.about: Q-Line Biotech Ltd. (QBL) is engaged in the business of developing, manufacturing and marketing of diverse range of reagents (including kits and POC devices) & consumables and manufacturing, importing, distribution/supply of diagnostic equipment for different diagnostic healthcare needs. The company supplies diagnostic equipment and IVD products for different diagnostic healthcare needs since 2013 directly or through its distributor/s majorly to diagnostic service providers, hospitals and medical colleges. The company has established its brands over a period of 12 years through its experience, R & D, manufacturing capabilities and quality assurance. The core segments of operations of the Company in IVD Industry include Clinical Chemistry, Haematology, Immunodiagnostics, Molecular Diagnostics and Others (POC Devices & Rapids). QBL’s key manufacturing segments include indigenous manufacturing of reagents including Clinical Chemistry, Haematology, Immunodiagnostics, Molecular Diagnostics and Others (POC Devices & Rapids) and supplying/ manufacturing of in-vitro diagnostics (IVD), Pathology equipment’s & devices. Further during the Covid-19 pandemic, the company diversified its focus…

ipos.name: Liqvd Digital
ipos.about: Liqvd Digital is one of the leading companies in terms of digital marketing, helping brands build their online presence and drive business growth. Further, their services include social media, media buying, SEO, content creation, influencer campaigns, and website/app development. The agency serves clients of all sizes, from direct-to-consumer startups to large enterprises across industries like FMCG, IT, finance, and healthcare. Headquartered in India with offices in Mumbai and Gurgaon and a Mumbai content studio, they also maintain a US presence through a partnership with AdLift Inc. Further, the key strength is End-to-end digital marketing capabilities, an experienced management team, a diversified client base, and many more.

ipos.name: Pooja Logistics
ipos.about: Founded in 2011, Pooja Logistics is a temperature-controlled logistics service provider for perishable goods, operating refrigerated trucks across India. The firm helps businesses safely transport perishable goods, such as confectionery and bakery products, Dairy Products, QSR items, pharmaceuticals and healthcare products, and e-commerce and retail products, to other locations using its temperature-controlled logistics. Its cold-chain logistics services serve a diverse range of industries. As of March 2026, the firm is equipped with over 424 in-house GPS-enabled vehicles for the transportation of temperature-sensitive goods. Pooja Logistics is known for transporting temperature-sensitive products while maintaining operational systems follows required laws and regulations.

ipos.name: Anand Seamless
ipos.about: Since its foundation in 2005, Anand Seamless has been involved in the manufacturing of seamless tubes, pipes, and finned tubes. Its product portfolio consists of carbon steel and alloy steel seamless tubes, heat exchanger tubes, U-tubes, and various types of finned tubes used in various industries such as oil & gas, petrochemicals, power plants, and process industries. Its products cater to both domestic and international markets. In India, Anand Seamless sells its products to the heat exchanger industry, Petroleum Industries, Pharmaceutical Industries, Chemical Industries, Oil and gas refineries, railways, boiler Manufacturing, chemical Industries, Textile Machinery, and Transportation sectors, Automobile Industries, Defense Sector, and Cement Industries. Moreover, its manufacturing facility is located at Survey No. 944, Chhatral Kadi Road, Nr. Ankhol Patiya, Indrad, Kadi, Gujarat 382715, India.

ipos.name: Himalaya Nutravedics
ipos.about: Founded in 2022, Himalaya Nutravedics is an Ayurvedic and nutraceutical manufacturing firm involved in the formulation, manufacturing, and marketing of Ayurvedic and nutraceutical products. Its product portfolio includes Softgel Capsules, Tablets, Medicated Oils, Liquid Orals, Hardgel Capsules, and Protein Powders across therapeutic categories such as digestive health, immunity, metabolic health, and pain management. The firm sells its products under its own brands and also sells them through doctors, hospitals, clinics, pharmacists, or other healthcare professionals. The firm has expanded its portfolio across 17 states and one union territory in India. Moreover, its manufacturing facility is located at is located in Hyderabad, Telangana, and holds WHO-GMP certifications. Its competitive strengths are strong relationships with suppliers and customers and Integrated multi-dosage manufacturing capability.

ipos.name: Vivekanand Cotspin
ipos.about: Incorporated in July 2015, Vivekanand Cotspin Limited is engaged in cotton processing and yarn manufacturing through cotton ginning, spinning, and trading activities. The company produces a range of products, including cotton bales, cotton seeds, and various types of yarn. Vivekanand Cotspin operates primarily in two segments: cotton ginning and cotton spinning. The company specialises in converting clean cotton fibres into quality yarn for domestic and international markets. Its product portfolio includes carded and combed cotton yarn, which is supplied to industries involved in fabric manufacturing. With modern spinning facilities and efficient machinery, the company focuses on maintaining quality standards while serving both Indian and export markets.

ipos.name: Robokidz Eduventures
ipos.about: Founded in December 2014, Robokidz Eduventures is an education technology company that offers learning and skill development solutions for K-12 students in Robotics, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Coding, Electronics, and STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics). The company offers complete educational laboratory setup solutions, including subscription-based learning programs, teacher training, digital learning platforms, educational kits, and technical support to schools, educational institutions, and government organizations across India. Robokidz Eduventures runs its business with models such as Educational Laboratory Setup Projects, subscription-based Young Engineers Garage (YEG) programs, STEM workshops, boot camps, and franchise-based Young Engineers Academy (YEA) activity centres. Furthermore, as of March 2026, the firm has hired 24 professionals across various management roles.

ipos.name: FX Multitech
ipos.about: Since its foundation in March 2008, FX Multitech has mainly sold and distributed various types of products used in HVAC (Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning) and industrial refrigeration industries. The firm provides a wide range of engineering and refrigeration products, including compressors, refrigeration and air-conditioning controls, industrial refrigeration controls, variable frequency drives and automation products, specialized components and tools, heat exchangers, cold room evaporators, refrigerants and ancillary products. FX Multitech sources its products from various global suppliers and has a diversified distribution network with its headquarters in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, and warehouses in Hyderabad, Thane, Kolkata and Bangalore. Moreover, the firm is also exporting its products, trying to expand its presence in international markets.

ipos.name: Axiom Gas Engineering
ipos.about: Axiom Gas Engineering, founded in 2007, is one of the leading green energy engineering solutions providers. The firm offers Auto LPG, CNG, and LNG solutions to retail and industrial sectors. The company provides various services: Gas and Pipe Engineering, Turnkey Services, Technical Consultancy, Maintenance, Operation, Training, and Manufacturing Pressure Vessels. The company operates 20+ Auto LPG Dispensing Stations (ALDS) under the name “PRIMEFUEL” across multiple states in India, including Telangana, Karnataka, and Maharashtra.
